dockets.what: Large-load tariff for customers 25 MW and up (data centers), opened Oct 2025 on joint petition of PSC staff and the Public Advocate; PSC paused interconnection of new large loads in Delmarva territory until the tariff is set. Delmarva filed a proposed tariff Dec 19, 2025; Starwood Digital Ventures, DNREC, Walmart and unions intervened
dockets.status: pending; interconnection pause in effect (no final order found)

laws_and_bills.name: HB 233
laws_and_bills.what: Would require PSC-regulated utilities to create a separate rate class and tariff for large energy users so their costs are not shifted to homes and small businesses

laws_and_bills.name: SB 205
laws_and_bills.what: Would require a PSC certificate (renamed 'transmission certificate') before a facility uses 100 MW or more (amended up from 30 MW); PSC to act within 90 days with one extension

local_rules.what: Data center rules for new projects: buffers, 1,000 ft from nearest home (500 ft with noise study), efficient backup generators, closed-loop cooling, decommissioning funds; signed by County Executive Marcus Henry March 2026; does not apply to projects already in the pipeline

incentives.name: No data-center-only incentive; general Blue Collar Jobs Act credits
incentives.law: 30 Del. C. ch. 20, subchapters II-III and V (e.g., 30 Del. C. 2011)
incentives.what: NCSL's 2026 table (adapted from Husch Blackwell's 50-state survey, updated 2026-07-27) lists Delaware's general Blue Collar Jobs Act business credits as the incentive available to data centers; no data-center-specific exemption was found. Delaware has no general sales tax. Data: https://datawrapper.dwcdn.net/TQYDf/5/dataset.csv
